recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Treat future changes to the MedicationAdministration.statusReason example ValueSet as current terminology issues rather than as further FHIR-5995 work.
issue_request: FHIR-5995 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy correction for DSTU1 MedicationAdministration. It reported that the page for http://hl7.org/fhir/vs/reason-medication-not-given-codes did not show any codes or references to existing codes and looked like a placeholder; the Jira comment says the problem was a wrong supplied narrative and that it was corrected.
initial_application: Git commit 28517596ca7df38a3d18ef025b503a7ea109821a explicitly applied #5995 by removing the hand-written generated narrative block from source/medicationadministration/valueset-reason-medication-not-given-codes.xml, leaving terminology content to drive the generated rendering instead of stale placeholder prose.
additional_context: MedicationAdministration is still an active, approved core resource, and MedicationAdministration.statusReason binds to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/reason-medication-not-given-codes. The current ValueSet source has no hand-written narrative block and composes SNOMED CT hierarchy filters, so it no longer has the FHIR-5995 placeholder-only defect. Later same-artifact terminology work, including FHIR-9552 already on the combined branch, changed the ValueSet content and description but does not require another FHIR-5995 edit.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scope source already satisfies the FHIR-5995 correction, and adding a local hand-written narrative would risk the same drift the historical fix removed.
